issues.display_title: Issue #901: [Tour Detail] Update Loading Caption While Checking Panorama
issues.main_description_html:
Enhancement — Loading Caption While Checking Panorama (Tour Detail)

Area: Tour Detail → panorama check/validation step (pre-upload / sync) Context (from project analysis): Recommendation #2 in the analysis is to replace silent states with user-surfaced feedback on the capture → connect → upload path. During the "checking panorama" step the UI currently shows a generic/ambiguous loader, leaving the user unsure whether the app is frozen, verifying, or uploading.

Related: Pairs with #900 (Fix Retry Upload Condition), where the retry flow checks each local panorama against GoThru. This caption surfaces that per-panorama check to the user.

Update: The loading caption has been changed — it now shows "Checking panorama {filename}.jpg", naming the specific panorama file currently being checked against GoThru (instead of a generic spinner or a plain count).

Problem

While the app checks panoramas (existence, dimensions, gothru_exist, upload state) the loading indicator showed no meaningful caption, so users perceived the app as stuck and might force-close it — risking interrupted work.

Expected Behavior

  • The loading overlay during panorama checking shows a clear, localized caption naming the current file: "Checking panorama {filename}.jpg".
  • {filename} is the actual panorama filename being checked and updates as the app iterates through each local panorama.
  • Caption text is translatable across all 15 supported locales (only the static label is localized; the {filename} value is interpolated).

Acceptance Criteria

  • Caption shown during the panorama-checking phase reads "Checking panorama {filename}.jpg" with the real filename interpolated.
  • Caption advances to the next filename as each panorama is checked (does not stay frozen on one file).
  • The static label portion is sourced from i18n (no hardcoded English); the filename is interpolated, not translated.
  • Caption clears correctly on success and on error.

🧪 Test Scenarios (for QA)

TC-1 — Caption shows the current filename

  1. Open a tour with several panoramas and trigger the check/upload flow.
  2. Expected: Loading overlay displays "Checking panorama {filename}.jpg" with an actual panorama filename (not a bare spinner, not a literal {filename} placeholder).

TC-2 — Caption advances per panorama

  1. Use a tour with many panoramas (e.g. 10+).
  2. Observe the caption during checking.
  3. Expected: The filename in the caption changes as each panorama is checked and does not stay stuck on one file.

TC-3 — Localization

  1. Switch app language (e.g. to one of the non-English supported locales).
  2. Repeat the check flow.
  3. Expected: The "Checking panorama …" label appears translated; the filename remains the real filename; no missing-key / raw-key text.

TC-4 — Success path

  1. Let the check complete normally.
  2. Expected: Caption/overlay dismisses cleanly and flow proceeds to next step.

TC-5 — Error path

  1. Force an error during checking (e.g. corrupt/missing panorama file).
  2. Expected: Loader dismisses and a clear error message is shown — no infinite spinner with a stale "Checking panorama …" caption.

TC-6 — Filename edge cases

  1. Use panoramas with long filenames and/or special characters.
  2. Expected: Caption renders the filename without truncating the layout or breaking the overlay; ".jpg" suffix displays as expected.

Platforms: Android + iOS Regression watch: overall check/upload timing unaffected; no new blocking/freeze.

🧪 QA Tester Results — ✅ PASSED

TC-1 — Caption shows the current filename TC-2 — Caption advances per panorama TC-3 — Localization TC-4 — Success path TC-5 — Error path TC-6 — Filename edge cases

issues.display_title: Issue #900: [Tour Detail] Fix Retry Upload Condition
issues.main_description_html:
Bug — Retry Upload Condition (Tour Detail / Upload)

Area: Tour Detail → Publish & Upload flow (project-detail → /streeteditor/upload-tour) Context (from project analysis): The capture → connect → upload path is the core value funnel. Upload reliability directly drives the "tours published per active user" metric. Today, error handling on this path is weak (silent catch), so a failed upload that should be retryable may not retry — or a completed upload may incorrectly re-trigger a retry.

Problem

The retry-upload condition does not evaluate correctly: tours that fail mid-upload (e.g. dropped connection, partial panorama upload) either (a) do not offer/allow a retry, or (b) retry even when the upload already succeeded, causing duplicate/looping uploads.

Expected Behavior

  • The retry condition is determined by checking each local panorama on GoThru — for every local panorama, verify whether it already exists on GoThru (gothru_exist); only panoramas not yet present on GoThru are (re)uploaded.
  • A tour that fails or is interrupted during upload should be flagged as retryable, and tapping Retry should resume/re-attempt only the unfinished work (the panoramas missing on GoThru).
  • A tour that has fully uploaded (all local panoramas confirmed present on GoThru) should NOT show a retry state and should NOT re-upload.
  • Retry must respect connectivity and storage checks before starting.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Retry condition is derived from checking each local panorama against GoThru (existence check), not from a single tour-level flag.
  • Retry button appears only when at least one local panorama is missing on GoThru (failed/interrupted).
  • Retry resumes pending panoramas/connections without re-uploading ones already present on GoThru.
  • No duplicate tours/panoramas created on the GoThru side after retry.
  • Upload status (uploaded, virtual_tour_status) reflects the true server state after the check.

🧪 Test Scenarios (for QA)

TC-1 — Checking each local panorama on GoThru

  1. Open a tour where only some panoramas have uploaded (e.g. 3 of 6 present on GoThru).
  2. Trigger the upload/retry flow.
  3. Expected: The app checks each local panorama against GoThru and identifies which already exist vs which are missing.
  4. Expected: Only the missing panoramas (and their connections) are queued for (re)upload; the 3 already on GoThru are skipped.
  5. Expected: After completion, all 6 local panoramas are confirmed present on GoThru exactly once.

TC-2 — Retry after network drop

  1. Start uploading a tour with multiple panoramas.
  2. Disable WiFi/mobile data mid-upload (after at least 1 panorama uploads).
  3. Wait for the upload to fail.
  4. Expected: Tour shows a retryable/failed state with a Retry action.
  5. Re-enable network, tap Retry.
  6. Expected: The per-panorama GoThru check runs; only the not-yet-uploaded panoramas/connections are sent; upload completes; status = uploaded.

TC-3 — No retry on fully uploaded tour

  1. Upload a tour to 100% completion (all local panoramas confirmed on GoThru).
  2. Return to Tour Detail.
  3. Expected: No Retry prompt; tour shows "uploaded/published"; re-opening does not start a new upload.

TC-4 — Retry blocked when offline

  1. Put device fully offline.
  2. Open a failed tour and tap Retry.
  3. Expected: App shows the "no internet connection" message and does not start a broken upload (the GoThru check cannot run offline).

TC-5 — Retry with insufficient storage / quota

  1. Trigger upload where user storage quota is exceeded (or device low storage).
  2. Expected: Clear, user-visible error; retry condition does not loop silently.

TC-6 — No duplicates on server

  1. Force one failure + one successful retry on the same tour.
  2. Open the tour on the GoThru platform/web.
  3. Expected: Exactly one tour, no duplicated panoramas or connections (the per-panorama GoThru check prevents re-uploading existing ones).

Platforms: Android + iOS Regression watch: normal (first-try) upload still succeeds end-to-end.

🧪 QA Tester Results — ✅ PASSED

TC-1 — Checking each local panorama on GoThru

TC-2 — Retry after network drop

TC-3 — No retry on fully uploaded tour

TC-4 — Retry blocked when offline

TC-6 — No duplicates on server
